objective: The private strict encoding of the signed cycle projects exactly to the intended product reports and a checked degree-two proof can derive and cancel all check equations with a linear number of charged pair definitions and nodes for fixed local arity.
status: Proved: The strict private-chain encoding projects to the claimed pair equations and every clause of an odd cycle is necessary. A formal degree-two refutation uses one shared and one local product definition per report and derives every check from strict input. Every odd cycle has a linear-node proof.
title: Derive the quadratic parity equations from actual strict clauses
